questions.question: Check the list of foreign academies, the description of Chebyshev’s school, the title and date of his work on mechanisms, and the source of Markov’s recollection.

localizations.source: Check the list of foreign academies, the description of Chebyshev’s school, the title and date of his work on mechanisms, and the source of Markov’s recollection.
localizations.ru: Проверить перечень иностранных академий, описание школы Чебышёва, название и дату работы о механизмах и источник воспоминания Маркова.

questions.resolution: The exact unsupported society count was removed; the school is described without asserting that every named mathematician was a direct pupil; the 1854 title is given more precisely, and Markov’s unsourced direct quotation is paraphrased as a recollection.

questions.question: Clarify the number of Chebyshev’s mechanisms and their modifications.

localizations.source: Clarify the number of Chebyshev’s mechanisms and their modifications.
localizations.ru: Уточнить число механизмов Чебышёва и их модификаций.

questions.resolution: Corrected from the official IS ARAN record: more than forty different mechanisms and around eighty modifications.

questions.question: Identify the original work and creator of the Chebyshev portrait cover, and provide a public source and license or a verified public-domain basis.

localizations.source: Identify the original work and creator of the Chebyshev portrait cover, and provide a public source and license or a verified public-domain basis.
localizations.ru: Установить исходное произведение и автора портретной обложки Чебышёва, указать публичный источник и лицензию либо подтверждённое основание общественного достояния.

questions.question: Confirm the original publication date of 4 September 2023 using an accessible public record of the original publication.
